summary: Targeted retest of the AI-call persistence bug fix. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with a new TestAICallIdempotency class (repeat ai-call on a custom lead + on the star lead Rahul) — 27/27 pytest passing. Confirmed POST /api/leads/{id}/ai-call is idempotent: after 2 calls exactly ONE Scheduled Site Visit appointment and ONE Scheduled follow-up remain, lead fields (score/status/budget/requirement/timeline/location/financing/intent) persisted, and the global /api/appointments list also shows exactly one appointment for that lead. Frontend (Playwright, real public URL): (1) demo login -> Leads -> Add Lead (budget ₹2.2 Cr / 3BHK / 45 days) -> profile shows 15/100 COLD, 0 appointments; (2) Start AI Call -> transcript plays -> call-result panel shows score/temp/Status→APPOINTMENT/Saturday 11:30 AM/Follow-up created; (3) CLOSE VIA ESCAPE -> profile immediately refreshed to the persisted values (79/100, APPOINTMENT badge, AI Lead Summary, score breakdown, extracted info budget ₹2.2 Cr / 3BHK / Gurgaon / 45 days / Home Loan / High, 1 appointment card 'Site Visit Saturday · 11:30 AM · 2026-09-05', 1 follow-up card) — NOT stale 15/COLD; (4) browser reload keeps identical values; (5) running the AI call a 2nd time still yields exactly 1 appointment + 1 follow-up (2 call rows, expected); (6) BUTTON path with a second new lead (30 days) -> 91/100 HOT after 'View updated lead' and after reload; (7) cross-page: both leads appear in the Pipeline APPOINTMENT column, Appointments page shows their Site Visit, Calls page row opens summary+transcript modal; (8) REGRESSION: Rahul Sharma 42 -> 91/100 HOT / APPOINTMENT / Saturday 11:30 AM with 1 appointment + 1 follow-up, persisted after reload. No stale-state, no duplicate, and no console errors found (only a Radix aria-describedby warning).

minor.issue: Calls are not deduped (2nd run adds a 2nd call row for the same lead). Appointments/follow-ups are correctly replaced. Likely intentional (call history), noted for awareness only.
Still no organization_id scoping (IDOR / cross-tenant read) — carried over from iteration 1, unchanged.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix console warning remains: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' (DialogTitle error from iteration 1 is fixed).

issues: The LLM summary treats the lead NAME as a project/locality ('a 3BHK unit at QA Escape 10132, Gurgaon'), because the prompt appears to feed the lead name into the property context. Harmless for real names but reads oddly; consider prompt wording.

action_items: Optional: add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to AICallModal to clear the last Radix a11y warning
Optional: scope appointments/calls/activities/lead-by-id endpoints to the caller's organization_id (pre-existing)

Note for expectation alignment: a lead with timeline '45 days' scores 79/WARM (timeline gives +8, not +20). The review request expected ~86/HOT for a 45-day lead; if HOT is desired for 45 days, adjust compute_score thresholds — otherwise behaviour is correct as coded.
critical_code_review_comments: AICallModal runRef + completedRef guards correctly prevent the StrictMode double POST and duplicate parent refresh; close() -> fireComplete(result) covers backdrop/Escape/End-call/finish paths. Verified in-browser.

Backend delete_many before insert makes the ai-call endpoint idempotent for appointments/follow-ups; consider doing the same for the follow-up type filter to avoid deleting unrelated user-created scheduled follow-ups for the lead (currently ALL Scheduled follow-ups of that lead are deleted).
server.py remains >800 lines and mixes seed/scoring/LLM/routes — still worth splitting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (escape-close, button-close, reload persistence, no-duplicates, 2nd call idempotency, pipeline/appointments/calls cross-page, Rahul regression)

seed_data_creation: Created 'QA Escape 10132' and 'QA Button 10222' leads plus TEST_ leads; all deleted afterwards with /app/backend/tests/cleanup_qa_leads.py (which also removed the stale 'Mayank Test' x3 and 'Persist QA' leads left by earlier runs). Rahul Sharma reset to CONTACTED/42 via reset_rahul.py — demo DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug is fixed and verified end-to-end. Run `python /app/backend/tests/reset_rahul.py` before demoing/retesting the star flow and `python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_qa_leads.py` afterwards to purge QA/TEST/Mayank/Persist leads. Backend suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q -n 0`. Non-star lead scores depend on the timeline string (30 days -> 91/HOT, 45 days -> 79/WARM). Pipeline drag-and-drop still not exercised.
rca_of_the_issue: Original defect (stale profile after non-button close + StrictMode duplicate POST) no longer reproduces. Escape-close now refreshes the lead via onComplete->load() and the DB holds exactly one appointment/follow-up per lead because the backend deletes existing Scheduled Site Visit/follow-up docs before inserting. Verified via UI (card counts) and API (GET /api/leads/{id} and /api/appointments).
